content.short: Davos Protocol is a cross-chain lending and borrowing platform enabling users to borrow the DUSD Stable Asset.
content.description: Davos Protocol is a cross-chain lending and borrowing platform that lets users borrow the DUSD Stable Asset, initially backed by staked MATIC as collateral. Built on a MakerDAO-style architecture, it aims to deliver a native stable asset with a sustainable yield generated via liquid staking. Its multi-stakeholder approach focuses on sustainable growth, reduces locked liquidity, and maintains price stability, helping users maximize returns while managing risk across Polygon, Solana, Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum.
